name: @openlance/aios-automation-intelligence
description: Phase 5 Stage 8 Automation Intelligence: the eighth and final AI Growth OS Feature, a deterministic domain subsystem that owns the automation-planning behavior only (ADR-0056). The Growth Workflows -> Automation step of the chain: it consumes a Growth Workflows output (a GrowthWorkflow, by reference, carrying the six planner references transitively) plus knowledge by reference, and frames a governed automation opportunity: an immutable AutomationPlan carrying the frozen Agent Engine AgentRequest (prompt, provider steps), plus an automation-quality EvaluationRequest for the frozen Evaluation Engine. It is deterministic and fail-closed; it never executes, schedules, or orchestrates automation, never bypasses GovernanceClearance, never duplicates Runtime Execution, never invokes a provider or decides, and builds no new platform infrastructure.
